title: Discontinuation of false or misleading advertisement
description: Discontinuation of advertisement that is false or misleading and prejudicial to consumer interest

content.available_when: The Central Authority is satisfied after investigation that any advertisement is false or misleading and is prejudicial to the interest of any consumer or is in contravention of consumer rights
conditions: The Central Authority is satisfied after investigation
advertisement is prejudicial to the interest of any consumer
advertisement is in contravention of consumer rights
limitations: within such time as may be specified in that order
